request.recipient: Intersect treasury reserve stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with execution by AlphaGrowth under Operating Group oversight and Intersect fund management.
request.what: Fund Cardano PRIME, a 12-month community-overseen program to improve DeFi protocol readiness, activate incentives, and grow durable liquidity across Cardano markets.

claims.claim: Cardano PRIME is a 12-month program intended to improve DeFi protocol readiness, activate incentives responsibly, and grow durable liquidity across Cardano markets.
The withdrawal requests 120000000 ada, with USD planning figures based on a $0.16 per ADA assumption.
Program funds are to be managed directly by Intersect in a separate auditable account rather than unilaterally held or controlled by AlphaGrowth.
The proposal makes the withdrawal conditional on an applicable Net Change Limit under TREASURY-01a having enough remaining capacity to cover the withdrawal in full at enactment.
As of June 2026, Cardano DeFi has approximately $90M in TVL and $45M in stablecoin supply.
The program uses a phased model in which Phase 3 incentives and capital are deployed only after the Operating Group affirms the Phase 3 release plan.
The proposal allocates 2000000 ada for independent audit or assurance and references two audit reports for the budget management smart contracts.
AlphaGrowth has not received Cardano Treasury funding within the prior 24 months.
The performance fee is tied to verified qualifying TVL growth, excluding ADA price effects and non-PRIME-attributable TVL under the attribution methodology.
The proposal defines six return triggers for unused, unearned, unreleased, or excess funds.

summary: The document requests a 120000000 ada treasury withdrawal for a 12-month DeFi growth program executed by AlphaGrowth with Intersect custody, Operating Group oversight, phased release gates, audit funding, quarterly reporting, attribution-based performance fees, NCL conditionality, and return-to-treasury triggers.
